meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求解释代码库中某个具体文件、函数或模块时，Claude 会先检查知识图谱是否存在，若存在则定位目标节点及其关联节点，并阅读对应源文件，最终给出该组件在架构中的角色、内部结构、外部连接和数据流等深入说明。
howto.when: 当用户请求深入解释代码库中某个具体文件、函数或模块时触发。如果知识图谱文件不存在，会先提示用户运行 /understand。

say.text: 帮我深入解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件
say.note: 会从知识图谱里找这个文件的节点和相关依赖。

say.text: verifyToken 这个函数是做什么的？它在架构中处于什么位置？
say.note: 会定位该函数节点，分析它的调用关系和依赖。

say.text: 这个模块的数据流是怎样的？
say.note: 会读源文件，梳理输入、处理、输出的过程。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for a deep-dive explanation of a code component, Claude checks the knowledge graph for the target node, reads connected nodes and the source file, then explains its architectural role, internal structure, connections, and data flow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase. If the knowledge graph is missing, it prompts the user to run /understand first.

say_en.note: It finds this file's node and related dependencies in the graph.

say_en.text: What does verifyToken do, and where does it sit in the architecture?
say_en.note: It locates the function node and analyzes connections.

say_en.text: What is the data flow of this module?
say_en.note: It reads the source file and traces inputs, processing, and outputs.
